metadata.coverage_note: This file contains 135 districts from the ug-locale/passport-portal dataset. UBOS 2024 Statistical Abstract reports 146 districts, 11 cities including Kampala Capital City, and 31 municipalities; use an official UBOS/EC gazette source if you require legally current 2024/2026 boundaries.
